Ambush.description: Advantage on first strike when attacking from Stealth.

Bark_Roar.description: A booming alert that inspires allies and frightens prey.

Burrow.description: Can displace soft earth and move underground.

Camouflage.description: Naturally blends into the surrounding biome.

Click_Hiss.description: Echolocation pulse mixed with a warning hiss.

Cold Blooded.description: Vulnerable to Cold, Resistant to Fire.

Directional Tracking.description: Can pinpoint the exact trajectory of a moving target via disturbed earth.

Disease Immunity.description: Biological structure completely immune to terrestrial pathogens.

Dive.description: Extra damage on charge from above.

Echolocation.description: Active emission of sound waves to map surroundings.

Endurance.description: Advantage on Con saves vs Exhaustion.

Fire Resistance.description: Thick scales or integument that dissipates thermal energy.

Forage.description: Expertise in locating edible flora and hidden sustenance.

Grunt.description: A low, guttural sound to warn off intruders.

Heat Vision.description: Specialized pit organs capable of perceiving infrared thermal radiation.

Hibernate.description: Can drastically lower metabolic rate to survive extreme cold or starvation.

Hive Mind.description: Telepathic with others of same species.

Magic Immunity.description: Immune to spells lvl 3 and lower.

Magic Resistance.description: Innate nullification of localized arcane fluctuations.

Necrotic Resistance.description: Cellular structure that resists entropic decay.

Obsidian Skin.description: A dermal layer composed of dense, volcanic glass.

Poison Resistance.description: A highly robust liver and immune system that filters blood-borne toxins.

Psionic.description: Capable of projecting thought-forms and telekinetic force.

Reaction Strike.description: Lightning-fast reflexes allow for immediate retaliation when engaged.

Reflective Carapace.description: Chitinous armor polished to mirror sheen, scattering light and energy.

Scavenger.description: A specialized digestive tract immune to rot and carrion diseases.

Schooling.description: Advantage vs Fear if near allies.

Sure-Footed.description: Exceptional balance. Advantage on checks to avoid being knocked prone.

Thermal Vision.description: Eyes adapted to perceive heat signatures through absolute darkness.

Thick Fur.description: Dense pelage providing excellent insulation against freezing temperatures.

Tracking.description: Mastery of reading broken twigs, disturbed dust, and faint scents.

Undead Nature.description: Does not require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Water Retention.description: Specialized kidneys and pores that drastically slow dehydration.
